text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few weeks before Admire Vega runs in the Hopeful Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And that was our debut race at Hanshin Racecourse under today's wintry rain! The favorite, Narita Top Road, missed out on first place by a neck, finishing a close second!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aaaah… Top Road, you were sooo close!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Could it have been her form? She looked a cut above the rest while in the paddock. I guess maybe she needs more time…

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hey, you'll be fine, Top Road! I know you're training so hard every day! You'll definitely win the next race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry for such a disappointing performance! But…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time, I promise I'll do everything I can to deliver a good result!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Please continue to cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Awww, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely be there to support you! So just keep doing your best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'll get it next time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time moves forward, and the day of the Hopeful Stakes arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to both the fame of her mother and her own innate talent, Admire Vega's popularity has skyrocketed recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even from the prep room, the thunderous cheering of the crowd can be heard. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say the majority of it is directed at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she doesn't seem to take notice…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can you show me the race schedule? There's something I want to check.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems quite unmoved, just like after her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Single-mindedly determined to amass victories in dedication to her late sister, she is largely unaffected by her surroundings.
choice_data_list: (I guess we could consider it her strength.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as I'm lost in thought…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hello! Sorry, it's me, Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um! Are you in the middle of a meeting or anything?
choice_data_list: It's fine. Did you come to give her your support?
It's fine. Did you come to give her your support?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Today is an important race for Ayabe, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You have a race tomorrow as well, right? Shouldn't you spend your time preparing for that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Well, actually, I had a slightly disappointing result at my debut race the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But seeing my classmates race reenergizes me, so I came here for my own benefit!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Well, I guess there's no problem then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You know, you're really amazing, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Did you read Twinkle Monthly's popularity poll?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The survey Narita Top Road mentions is one of many conducted by the popular publication Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the lead up to big events, the magazine conducts polls online and collects the opinions of its journalists, then releases the information in the form of pre-race popularity rankings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although actual popularity on the day of the race is a different story, the survey is respected as one way of measuring the potential of the racers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Among all the talented junior-year runners taking on the Hopeful Stakes, you're listed as the favorite, just like you were before your debut.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's incredible. You can hear everyone talking about you just by taking a short walk through the stands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: They're all… expecting you to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So, um… well…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It must be difficult… even scary. What if you can't live up to those expectations?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, um! Sorry! What am I saying? Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My purpose hasn't changed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't care who or what is around me. Even if I experience difficulty or pain, if I'm at a disadvantage, or if I'm being reckless or naive…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: None of it matters as long as I bear the burden I've taken on and see it to its end…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's what I call "resolve."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Resolve…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Resolve is crucial, especially when you're alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: When the only things that can give you momentum are your own two feet, they become an unwavering force against the turf below.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega then exits the prep room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a stride that bears an unwavering resolve… she advances toward her solitary battle, the Hopeful Stakes.
